name: Carroll County, GA
findings: Carroll County has 317 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carroll County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 26 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
